title: Some iPhone Duo Models Are Breaking. iFixit’s Teardown Might Explain Why
gist: A small number of Apple's first foldable, the $1,999 iPhone Duo, are cracking on the inner screen shortly after opening ('crackgate'); Apple acknowledges the issue and offers AppleCare replacements. iFixit's teardown theorizes a hinge center support bar creates a mid-screen stress point, while awarding a provisional 5/10 repairability score, the highest it has given any foldable.

insights.claim: Reddit reports indicate that a small number of Apple iPhone Duo units suffer inner-screen cracks when opened, sometimes as early as device setup, an issue users have dubbed 'crackgate'.
insights.speaker: Boone Ashworth
insights.so_what: Early quality defects on Apple's first foldable could dent launch-cycle sentiment and raise warranty costs.

insights.claim: Apple has acknowledged an issue affecting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units and directs affected users to AppleCare for a replacement.
insights.speaker: Boone Ashworth
insights.so_what: Official acknowledgment and replacement policy signals Apple treats it as contained, limiting but not eliminating recall-style risk.
insights.quote: We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units.

insights.claim: The iPhone Duo screen failures tend to surface quickly after use rather than days after unboxing, and WIRED's review unit showed no issues after more than two weeks of daily use.
insights.speaker: Boone Ashworth
insights.so_what: Early-failure pattern suggests a manufacturing/tolerance defect rather than a progressive wear issue affecting the whole installed base.

insights.claim: iFixit theorizes that during folding the iPhone Duo's center hinge support bar, across which a display cable passes, fails to get out of the way, creating a stress point in the middle of the inner screen that may cause the cracks.
insights.speaker: Boone Ashworth
insights.so_what: If the root cause is hinge design rather than a component batch, a fix may require hardware revision, not just supply changes.
insights.quote: the center support bar along the hinge fails to get out of the way as the screen folds, making a stress point right in the middle of the screen
